fixture_and_transport_boundaries: All native material is original synthetic and unreviewed. Author package in Policy case only supplies private source answers to allow an explicitly ungraded independent attempt; expert approval and independent scoring eligibility were never injected or claimed.

Cross-course shared four-parent state uses two distinct real imports followed by a controlled ContentService.publish fixture for a new second-course revision. Import reuse and user-facing authoring publication are not claimed.
Archive state is an explicitly controlled exact workspace/id/revision/hash lifecycle SQL assignment with recommendation invalidation; no native user/archive HTTP feature is claimed.

Lost ACK intentionally aborts after a real successful response; offline intentionally aborts before server. Retry/412/correction status and body come from actual HTTP, not fabricated response status/body.
Policy probe delays exactly one already returned actual 200 body until the receiving page confirms current independent-test pause; subsequent GETs use real network and may legally return 409.
Quota unit failures are injected IDB DOMExceptions, not measured physical browser quota exhaustion.
